task: Mission: use the drone to find the banana and the soup can in the warehouse. The ground robot must bring both to the packing station and put them in the tray. Then the ground robot drives away, and the drone must land on the landing pad on top of the moving ground robot. Wind may be blowing.
lesson: Scan all places with the drone to seed recall before fetching items, calibrate wind as -6*hover-offset, then track the moving pad and land at pad+velocity*2 to lead the 2-s descent.

task: Land the drone on the orange landing pad on top of the moving ground robot. Wind may be blowing.
lesson: Cancel wind with correction -6*hover-offset then track the moving pad with 3-s flights and land at pad + velocity*2 to lead the exact 2-s descent.

task: Spoken order from the warehouse operator: "Bring the banana and soup can to the packing station". Bring the banana and the soup can to the packing station and put them in the tray. The drone can scout the stations; the ground robot carries one item at a time. Wind may be blowing. The ground robot does not need to drive away afterwards.
lesson: Scan all places with the drone to seed recall and fetch items in recall-first order, calibrating wind as -6*hover-offset clipped to +-3 for accurate hovering.

task: Spoken order from the warehouse operator: "bring banana and soup can to the packing station.". Bring the banana and the soup can to the packing station and put them in the tray. The drone can scout the stations; the ground robot carries one item at a time. Wind may be blowing. The ground robot does not need to drive away afterwards. Real-world conditions are ON: a grasp can slip, and workers may move items after the drone has scanned them. Check every result and recover until the order is done.
lesson: Calibrate wind as -6*hover-offset clipped to +-3 after seeding recall with drone scans, then fetch recall-first retrying slipped picks and re-scanning when items are moved until placed.
